---
title: "4 · CNNs on Scientific Data and the 2D Ising Model"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

CNNs on scientific data: blood cells under the microscope (BloodMNIST) and land use from satellite images (EuroSAT), with confusion matrices and class activation maps. A physics example: the 2D Ising model, its partition function and Onsager's solution, and a CNN that locates the critical temperature from spin configurations alone; transfer learning, where a network pretrained on ImageNet does not help on blood cells but does on satellite images; the lecture closes with the Chinese Room thought experiment.
